ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in parallelogram $ABCD$, $E$ is the midpoint of side $AD$. Line segments $AC$ and $BE$ intersect at point $F$. If the area of $\triangle AEF$ is 2, then what is the area of $\triangle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because$ parallelogram ABCD\\
$\therefore$ $AD\parallel BC$ and $AD=BC$\\
$\because$ E is the midpoint of side AD\\
$\therefore$ BC=2AE\\
$\because$ $AE\parallel BC$\\
$\therefore$ $\angle EAC=\angle BCA$\\
Also, $\because$ $\angle EFA=\angle BFC$\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle AEF\sim \triangle CBF$\\
As illustrated, draw $FH\perp AD$ at point H and $FG\perp BC$ at point G,\\
then $\frac{EF}{BF}=\frac{AF}{CF}=\frac{AE}{BC}=\frac{HF}{FG}=\frac{1}{2}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{S_{\triangle AEF}}{S_{\triangle ABC}}=\frac{\frac{1}{2}\cdot AE\cdot FH}{\frac{1}{2}\cdot BC\cdot HG}=\frac{\frac{1}{2}BC\cdot FH}{BC\cdot 3FH}=\frac{1}{6}$,\\
$\because$ the area of $\triangle AEF$ is 2\\
$\therefore$ $S_{\triangle ABC}=6S_{\triangle AEF}=6\times 2=\boxed{12}$

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是平行四边形 ABCD，A 在左下，B 在右下，C 在右上，D 在左上；AD 为左侧斜边，BC 为右侧斜边，AB 与 DC 互相平行。点 E 在边 AD 上，线段 AC 从 A 连到 C，线段 BE 从 B 连到 E，两条线段在平行四边形内部交于 F。推理：因为 ABCD 是平行四边形，所以 AD ∥ BC 且 AD = BC。E 是 AD 的中点，所以 AE = AD/2，因此 AE = BC/2，即 AE:BC = 1:2；又因为 E 在 AD 上，所以 AE ∥ BC。由于 AF 与 CF 共线，AE ∥ BC，可得对应角相等；又 ∠EFA 与 ∠BFC 是对顶角，所以三角形 AEF 与三角形 CBF 相似。因此 EF:BF = AE:BC = 1:2。在线段 BE 上，BE = EF + FB，所以 EF:BE = 1:3。三角形 AEF 与三角形 ABE 以 EF、BE 为同一直线上的底，并且从 A 到直线 BE 的高相同，所以面积比 [AEF]:[ABE] = EF:BE = 1:3。已知 [AEF] = 2，所以 [ABE] = 6。又 E 是 AD 的中点，三角形 ABE 与 ABD 从 B 到 AD 的高相同，底边 AE:AD = 1:2，所以 [ABE]:[ABD] = 1:2，故 [ABD] = 12。平行四边形 ABCD 中，对角线 BD 将平行四边形分成面积相等的三角形 ABD 和 ABC，因此 [ABC] = [ABD] = 12。

图像描述：图中是平行四边形 ABCD，A 在左下，B 在右下，C 在右上，D 在左上；AB 与 DC 平行，AD 与 BC 平行。点 E 标在边 AD 上，线段 AC 从 A 连到 C，线段 BE 从 B 连到 E，两条线段在平行四边形内部交于 F。

推理：因为 ABCD 是平行四边形，所以 AD ∥ BC 且 AD = BC。又因为 E 是 AD 的中点，所以 AE = AD/2，因此 AE = BC/2，即 AE:BC = 1:2；并且 E 在 AD 上，所以 AE ∥ BC。由于 AF 与 CF 共线，AE ∥ BC，可得对应角相等；又 ∠EFA 与 ∠BFC 是对顶角，所以 △AEF ∼ △CBF。因此 EF:BF = AE:BC = 1:2。在线段 BE 上，BE = EF + FB，所以 EF:BE = 1:3。

△AEF 与 △ABE 以 EF、BE 为同一直线 BE 上的底，并且从 A 到直线 BE 的高相同，所以面积比 [AEF]:[ABE] = EF:BE = 1:3。已知 [AEF] = 2，所以 [ABE] = 6。

又因为 E 是 AD 的中点，△ABE 与 △ABD 从 B 到直线 AD 的高相同，底边 AE:AD = 1:2，所以 [ABE]:[ABD] = 1:2，故 [ABD] = 12。

最后，在平行四边形 ABCD 中，AB ∥ CD，△ABD 与 △ABC 共底 AB，且点 D、C 到直线 AB 的高相等，所以这两个三角形面积相等。因此 [ABC] = [ABD] = 12。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, in parallelogram $ABCD$, $E$ is the midpoint of side $AD$. Line segments $AC$ and $BE$ intersect at point $F$. If the area of $\triangle AEF$ is 2, then what is the area of $\triangle ABC$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because$ parallelogram ABCD\\
$\therefore$ $AD\parallel BC$ and $AD=BC$\\
$\because$ E is the midpoint of side AD\\
$\therefore$ BC=2AE\\
$\because$ $AE\parallel BC$\\
$\therefore$ $\angle EAC=\angle BCA$\\
Also, $\because$ $\angle EFA=\angle BFC$\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle AEF\sim \triangle CBF$\\
As illustrated, draw $FH\perp AD$ at point H and $FG\perp BC$ at point G,\\
then $\frac{EF}{BF}=\frac{AF}{CF}=\frac{AE}{BC}=\frac{HF}{FG}=\frac{1}{2}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{S_{\triangle AEF}}{S_{\triangle ABC}}=\frac{\frac{1}{2}\cdot AE\cdot FH}{\frac{1}{2}\cdot BC\cdot HG}=\frac{\frac{1}{2}BC\cdot FH}{BC\cdot 3FH}=\frac{1}{6}$,\\
$\because$ the area of $\triangle AEF$ is 2\\
$\therefore$ $S_{\triangle ABC}=6S_{\triangle AEF}=6\times 2=\boxed{12}$
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there is a parallelogram ABCD, A is at the lower left, B is at the lower right, C is at the upper right, and D is at the upper left; E is marked on side AD, at a position approximately the midpoint of AD; segment AC connects from A to C, segment BE connects from B to E, and the two lines intersect at the interior point F.

Reasoning: Use an affine coordinate model, because midpoints, parallel relationships, and area ratios remain unchanged under affine transformations. Let A=(0,0), B=(1,0), D=(0,1), then C=(1,1). Since E is the midpoint of AD, E=(0,1/2). Point F is on AC, and can be written as (t,t); point F is also on BE, and a point on BE can be written as (1-s,s/2). Let (t,t)=(1-s,s/2), obtaining t=1-s and t=s/2, so s=2t, substituting gives t=1-2t, that is 3t=1, t=1/3. Therefore F=(1/3,1/3).

Calculating area: In this standard model, [AEF]=1/2·|det((0,1/2),(1/3,1/3))|=1/12; [ABC]=1/2·|det((1,0),(1,1))|=1/2. So [ABC]/[AEF]=(1/2)/(1/12)=6. In the actual problem [AEF]=2, therefore [ABC]=6×2=12.
